sidebars.body_markdown: The company is offering 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 face value each, at an issue price printed as ₹[•] [^drhp-p29]. The price will be [•] times the ₹10 face value [^drhp-p55]. Proceeds are earmarked for working capital of ₹1,130 lakhs, or ₹11.30 crore, and general corporate purposes, where the amount is left as [x] and is not disclosed [^drhp-p48]. The Lead Manager is Mark Corporate Advisors Private Limited and the Registrar to the Issue is Bigshare Services Private Limited [^drhp-p31]. The excerpts do not state whether the shares are entirely a fresh issue or include an offer for sale.
sidebars.rationale: Gives the reader the offer's basic terms in one block before the objects and pricing discussion.
